content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for C-MET Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for C-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the C-MET recruitment is scheduled for 22 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by C-MET?
faq.answer: C-MET has announced a total of 5 vacancies for the posts of Project Scientist, Project Staff Technical, and Project Staff Admin.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the C-MET recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: The Project Scientist post offers a salary of Rs. 67000 + 30% HRA per month, plus one month's basic pay towards medical expenses.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Staff Technical?
faq.answer: For the Project Staff Technical position, candidates must possess a First Class (60%) Diploma in Electrical, Civil, or Instrumentation engineering.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for C-MET recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this C-MET recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these C-MET posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the C-MET office located for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the C-MET office in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 500051.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the C-MET walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the C-MET recruitment?
faq.answer: The positions announced by C-MET are on a contractual basis, meaning they are temporary appointments.
